attchmntText: Kanoria Chemicals & Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Kanoria Chemicals and Industries Limited has published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during a meeting held on 13th November 2026. The announcement was published in the Financial Express and Ekdin newspapers on 14th November 2026. The results are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.

attchmntText: Considered and approved the re-appointment of Shri Rajya Vardhan Kanoria (DIN: 00003792)as Managing Director for a term of 3 years with effect from 10 January, 2027, subject toapproval of shareholders.
voiceSummary: Kanoria Chemicals and Industries Limited held a Board Meeting on 13th November 2026. The Board considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board also considered the re-appointment of Shri Rajya Vardhan Kanoria, DIN 00003792, as Managing Director. This appointment is for a term of 3 years, effective from 10th January 2027 to 9th January 2030. The re-appointment is subject to shareholder approval. Shri Kanoria is currently the Managing Director. He is the spouse of Smt. Madhuvanti Kanoria and father of Shri Saumya Vardhan Kanoria. The meeting commenced at 11:30 a.m.

attchmntText: Kanoria Chemicals & Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Kanoria Chemicals and Industries Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported a half-year profit before tax of 6,637 lakhs and a net profit of 4,964 lakhs. Revenue from operations for the half year was 75,726 lakhs. The board also placed before shareholders the re-appointment of Shri Rajya Vardhan Kanoria as Managing Director for three years starting 10th January 2027. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified limited review report on the standalone financial results.
